settings.hero_desc: An open-side cutaway model of a containerised datacenter, revealing the internal racks and modules inside a branded shipping-container body. The clearest way to show clients exactly what is inside your modular product.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your unit, internal layout, branding and colours
settings.s1_body: This cutaway model opens one side of the container so clients can see the internal racks and modules at a glance - exactly how your modular datacenter is configured. Built to scale in your container colours and branding, it turns a sealed box into a clear, compelling sales story for meetings and exhibitions.
settings.case_heading: The Inside Story, on the Table
settings.case_body: Built as a cutaway display, this model let the manufacturer show prospects the internal layout of their containerised unit - answering the "what's inside?" question instantly and far more convincingly than a diagram.
settings.case_quote: Opening up the container in miniature sold the concept in seconds to investors. Brilliant sales tool.
settings.prov_p: Buyers trust what they can see. A cutaway model reveals the engineering inside a sealed product and turns a technical pitch into a clear, physical demonstration.
